findings.evidence: `rg` finds `SpecialLinear.pointsMulEquiv` in `SpecialLinear/Basic.lean` but no `SpecialLinear.schemePointsMulEquiv`; the parallel canonical API exists at `GeneralLinear/RootSubgroup.lean:204` (`rootSubgroup_def`) and `:285` (`@[simp] schemePointsMulEquiv_rootSubgroup`).
findings.fix: Add the SpecialLinear scheme-point equivalence/API and an analogous `@[simp] schemePointsMulEquiv_rootSubgroup` theorem; also provide `rootSubgroup_def` as the public presentation equation.
findings.issue: `rootSubgroup` has no public `rootSubgroup_def` or theorem computing its action on scheme-valued points, so consumers cannot connect the advertised scheme morphism to `c ↦ transvection hij c` without unfolding definitions.

summary: The scheme morphism lacks the characteristic scheme-valued-points API needed to use it without unfolding hidden presentations.
